strings.ix.faqH: Häufige Fragen zu Restaurants und Cafés in Al-Ahsa
strings.ix.faq0.q: Für welche traditionellen Gerichte ist Al-Ahsa bekannt?
strings.ix.faq0.a: Al-Ahsa ist bekannt für Gerichte wie Hasawi-Reis, Mandi, Harees und Dattelbrot.
strings.ix.faq0.linkText: Mehr zu den Gerichten auf der Seite Hasawi-Küche →
strings.ix.faq1.q: Gibt es Restaurants oder Cafés in der Nähe von Qasr Ibrahim?
strings.ix.faq1.a: Ja – zwei auf dieser Liste: Dar Basma neben dem Qasr-Ibrahim-Park und das Al-Koot Heritage Hotel Restaurant im Al-Koot-Viertel direkt gegenüber Qasr Ibrahim. Jede Karte verlinkt zu ihrem Standort in Google Maps.
strings.ix.faq2.q: Wo befinden sich die Cafés in der Altstadt von Hofuf?
strings.ix.faq2.a: Im historischen Zentrum von Hofuf und im Al-Rifaa-Nord-Viertel finden Sie: Baithana, Bait Al-Koot, Dar Huwaija an der König-Fahd-Straße, Al-Sayed Café, Ratio Al-Koot an der König-Abdulaziz-Straße und 7st direkt neben Qasr Ibrahim.
strings.ix.faq3.q: Wo kann ich das rote Hasawi-Brot kaufen?
strings.ix.faq3.a: Diese Seite hat einen eigenen Abschnitt für die Bäckereien des roten Brots – rotes Brot und Dattelbrot sind dasselbe –, jeweils mit Foto und Standort in Google Maps.
strings.ix.faq3.linkText: Mehr über Dattelbrot auf der Seite Hasawi-Küche →
strings.ix.faq4.q: Wo kann ich in Al-Mubarraz essen?
strings.ix.faq4.a: Zwei Orte dieser Liste liegen an der Ain-Najm-Straße in Al-Mubarraz: Baking Up und Dot Bakery & Café. Der Rest der Liste befindet sich in Hofuf.
strings.ix.faq5.q: Wo befinden sich diese Restaurants und Cafés?
strings.ix.faq5.a: Sie verteilen sich zwischen Hofuf – das historische Al-Koot-Viertel, das historische Zentrum von Hofuf, das Al-Rifaa-Nord-Viertel, Al-Khalidiyah, Al-Rawdah, Al-Mazrou', Al-Olaya, das Al-Uwaimriyah-Viertel und das Al-Khudud-Viertel – Al-Mubarraz an der Ain-Najm-Straße und Al-Qarah östlich der Oase; jede Karte verlinkt zur genauen Stelle in Google Maps.
strings.ix.faq6live.q: Woher stammen die Bewertungen und Öffnungszeiten?
strings.ix.faq6live.a: Bewertungen und Öffnungszeiten stammen direkt aus Google Maps (zuletzt aktualisiert {date}) und können sich ändern – öffnen Sie den Google-Maps-Link des jeweiligen Ortes für die aktuellsten Angaben. Preise werden nicht angegeben.
strings.ix.faq6static.q: Listet diese Seite Öffnungszeiten und Preise auf?
strings.ix.faq6static.a: Nein – wir veröffentlichen Öffnungszeiten, Preise oder Bewertungen erst, wenn sie durch offizielle Quellen bestätigt sind. Nutzen Sie den Google-Maps-Link des jeweiligen Restaurants für die aktuellsten Angaben.
strings.ix.methodP1: Dies ist eine erste Liste, die stetig wächst. Namen und Standorte stammen direkt aus Google Maps, und die Kurztexte sind knappe Einführungen, die jeden Ort so zeigen, wie er auf seinem Foto erscheint – sie beschreiben nur, ohne zu bewerten oder bestimmte Gerichte zu empfehlen.

termbase_additions.source: pack.json dist.mazrou (en: "Al-Mazrou‘", ar: "المزروع"); this batch's own brief flags it as distinct from the already-published termbase entry "Al-Mazrouiyah District → das Al-Mazrouiyah-Viertel" (a different district). Apostrophe rendered as straight U+0027, per the established convention at the published entries "Bayt Al-Bay'ah" and "Al-Shu'bah" ("der gerade Apostroph wird … beibehalten, kein typografisches '"), matching the spelling already used in src/content/dining/ammo.md and koud.md ("Al-Mazrou' district"). Stage 2 re-verified this reading directly against context.json termbase_terms_relevant (Al-Shu'bah, Al-Qurain, Al-Qou' entries all confirm straight U+0027 as house policy) — no change.
termbase_additions.note: Bare Ortsname, no '-Viertel' suffix: the Arabic dropdown/FAQ text never adds 'حي' for this district (unlike alkoot/khudud). Used identically in dist.mazrou and in ix.faq5.a.

termbase_additions.source: pack.json dist.khalidiyah (en/ar bare, no 'district'/'حي'). No existing termbase entry found. Transliteration unchanged per naming_policy.default.
termbase_additions.note: Bare form per brief instruction: no '-Viertel' unless Arabic says 'حي', which it does not here.

termbase_additions.source: pack.json dist.rawdah (en/ar bare). No existing termbase entry found. Transliteration unchanged per naming_policy.default.
termbase_additions.note: Bare form, same reasoning as Al-Khalidiyah.

termbase_additions.source: pack.json dist.olaya (en/ar bare). No existing termbase entry found. Transliteration unchanged per naming_policy.default.
termbase_additions.note: Bare form, same reasoning as Al-Khalidiyah.

termbase_additions.source: pack.json dist.khudud (en: "Al-Khudud", ar: "حي الخدود" — carries 'حي'). Formed exactly on the judge-confirmed pattern "Al-Koot District → das Al-Koot-Viertel" (durchkopplung + Genus 'das Viertel' per Duden).
termbase_additions.note: '-Viertel' added because the Arabic explicitly says 'حي' here (brief's own exception list: alkoot, khudud).

termbase_additions.source: pack.json ix.faq2.a ("Dar Huwaija on King Fahd Road"). Derived by the identical pattern as the published entry "King Abdulaziz Road → die König-Abdulaziz-Straße" (same construction: König + name + Straße, durchkopplung). Genus 'die Straße' per Duden, unstrittig.
termbase_additions.note: Web verification blocked in this environment; pattern-derived from an already judge-confirmed sibling entry, same class as 'die Ain-Najm-Straße' (status 'derived' there too, and now itself an already-published termbase entry per context.json). Stage 2: no reason found to prefer another form; kept, flagged for stage 4/7 web check as before.

termbase_additions.en: Historic downtown Hofuf (وسط الهفوف التاريخي) — standalone list-name form
termbase_additions.source: pack.json dist.downtown; batch BRIEF §1 explicitly distinguishes the published inline form 'im historischen Zentrum von Hofuf' (src/content/attractions/craftsmen-souq.md, koot-park.md) from the standalone dropdown-option form, which the brief itself gives verbatim as 'Historisches Zentrum von Hofuf'. Genus 'das Zentrum' per Duden.
termbase_additions.note: Two case-inflected surface forms of the same name are expected by design: capitalized noun-phrase for the dropdown (dist.downtown), lower-cased adjective inline in ix.faq2.a/ix.faq5.a ('das historische Zentrum von Hofuf') — this is ordinary German case agreement (strong vs. weak adjective declension), not an inconsistency. Stage 2 confirms this reading and keeps both forms unchanged.

termbase_additions.source: pack.json ix.faq3.q. Combines the established Nisba-compound pattern (Hasawi-Reis, Hasawi-Küche, Hasawi-Limette, Hasawi-Bischt) with the already-published phrase 'rotes Brot' (src/content/attractions/... published /de/food/ block: 'Auch als „rotes Brot“ (khubz ahmar) bekannt.').
termbase_additions.note: Stage 2 review of the stage-1 open question: kept 'das rote Hasawi-Brot' (adjective + Nisba-compound). A solid compound such as 'Hasawi-Rotbrot' would fabricate a German word not attested anywhere on the site, while the adjective form carries both source qualifiers ('red' and 'Hasawi') exactly and reads naturally next to the published 'rotes Brot' used two sentences later in ix.faq3.a — the two must visibly be 'the same thing' (C5b), which a diverging compound would obscure. No change.

termbase_additions.en: the Qasr Ibrahim park (حديقة قصر إبراهيم)
termbase_additions.source: pack.json ix.faq1.a context, which explicitly instructs: '«the Qasr Ibrahim park / حديقة قصر إبراهيم» ⇐ Durchkopplung'. Built from the published entry 'Qasr Ibrahim' (der, kept Latin per titel_regel) + Gattungswort 'Park' (durchkopplung per naming_policy). Genus 'der Park' per Duden.
termbase_additions.note: Distinct from the palace itself ('Qasr Ibrahim', bare, no article needed after prepositions per the published TM pair) — this entry is only for the park beside it.

termbase_additions.en: Al-Koot Heritage Hotel Restaurant (self-designation, as referenced in pack.json ix.faq1.a — NB entries.json's full legal name is 'Al-Koot Heritage Hotel & Restaurant', not a literal substring of this string)
termbase_additions.source: pack.json ix.faq1.a ("the Al-Koot Heritage Hotel Restaurant"); BINDING (de-stay judge, reused verbatim in this batch's context.json): self-designated Latin venue names are reproduced exactly as the venue spells itself, un-hyphenated inside the name even where Durchkopplung would otherwise apply. Genus 'das' from the compound head 'Restaurant' (neuter, Duden), needed because the sentence uses the definite article before it.
termbase_additions.note: Kept identical to the pack's own English wording (without '&'), not entries.json's full legal name, per instructions to translate the given source text.

notes: «directly opposite the fort» (en) vs «مقابل القصر» (ar) in ix.faq1.a: Arabic is authority per pack context and clearly refers back to Qasr Ibrahim (already named in the same sentence as 'the Qasr Ibrahim park'), matching the published /de/stay/ convention 'gegenüber Qasr Ibrahim' — rendered 'direkt gegenüber Qasr Ibrahim', not 'dem Fort' / 'der Festung'.

dist.downtown carries two legitimate surface forms by design (capitalized dropdown noun-phrase vs. lower-cased inline adjective phrase in ix.faq2.a/ix.faq5.a) — see the termbase_additions note on 'Historisches Zentrum von Hofuf'. This may produce a non-fatal warning in verify-stage's literal dist⇄faq5.a substring check; it is intentional and mirrors the brief's own explicit split between the two forms.

dist.rafah-north: chose the '-Viertel' form (Al-Rifaa-Nord-Viertel) over the bare 'Al-Rifaa-Nord', because the termbase already publishes exactly this string for the same district (src/content/attractions/hamidiyah-souq.md → area_de). Kept identical across dist.rafah-north, ix.faq2.a and ix.faq5.a.

'King Fahd Road' and the standalone 'Historisches Zentrum von Hofuf' are pattern-derived, not web-verified (WebFetch/WebSearch blocked in this environment for unesco.de/duden.de/de.wikipedia.org, per the precedent already accepted for 'König Abdulaziz' and 'Al-Omran') — flagged for stage 4/7.

'Hasawi red bread' rendered as 'das rote Hasawi-Brot' (adjective + Nisba-compound) — reviewed in stage 2, kept; see the amended termbase_additions note for the reasoning (avoids a fabricated solid compound and keeps the visible 'rotes Brot' / 'Dattelbrot' pairing required by C5b).
All em/en-dashes normalized to U+2013 with surrounding spaces per style_rules.gedankenstrich; the English/Arabic sources use U+2014, which is never carried into German.

Venue names (Dar Basma, Al-Koot Heritage Hotel Restaurant, Baithana, Bait Al-Koot, Dar Huwaija, Al-Sayed Café, Ratio Al-Koot, 7st, Baking Up, Dot Bakery & Café) reproduced exactly as given in pack.json's English source, Latin script, unmodified — per BINDING and per the venue-name guard in verify-stage.mjs.

STAGE 2 (editor) — resolved translator's open question on 'the historic Al-Koot district' (ix.faq5.a): context.json's tm_pairs_relevant records a judge-approved published sibling, src/content/attractions/abubakr-mosque.md → body_de, that translates the identical English phrase 'historic Al-Koot district' as 'historischen Al-Koot-Viertels'. This is the established site-wide precedent for this exact phrase, so 'historische(s)' is kept (not the 'Kulturerbe-' alternative the stage-1 brief raised as an open question) — reuse of an already-judged translation outranks a fresh terminology call for the same English string.

STAGE 2 — fixed a district-name consistency violation flagged by the batch's binding rule (each district name must read identically, allowing only grammatical inflection, across dist.*, ix.faq2.a and ix.faq5.a): ix.faq5.a previously read bare 'Al-Uwaimriyah', while dist.uwaimriyah (and the already-published termbase entry 'Al-Uwaimriyah District → das Al-Uwaimriyah-Viertel') carries '-Viertel'. Changed ix.faq5.a to 'das Al-Uwaimriyah-Viertel' so all appearances share the identical lexical form, differing only by the added article (permitted inflection). All other eleven district names appearing in both dist.* and ix.faq5.a were checked and are already identical up to grammatical inflection (dist.alkoot/downtown/rafah-north/khudud add only an article and/or the 'historisch(e)' qualifier already present verbatim in the English source; dist.khalidiyah/rawdah/mazrou/olaya/mubarraz/qarah are reproduced bare in both places).

STAGE 2 — editorial polish, no factual change: ix.faq0.a reworded 'ist für Gerichte wie … bekannt' → 'ist bekannt für Gerichte wie …' (keeps 'bekannt für' adjacent instead of splitting the Satzklammer across the whole list). ix.faq6live.a reordered '… öffnen Sie für die aktuellsten Angaben den Google-Maps-Link …' → '… öffnen Sie den Google-Maps-Link des jeweiligen Ortes für die aktuellsten Angaben' so the verb and its object sit together and the purpose phrase trails, matching normal German clause order.

STAGE 2 — removed the sole 'Entdecken Sie …' imperative (ix.faq0.linkText) as a house-style precaution: the published /de/stay/ sibling FAQ uses a non-imperative link pattern throughout ('Details auf der Seite Al-Uqair-Strand →'), and this batch's own ix.faq3.linkText is already non-imperative ('Mehr über Dattelbrot auf der Seite Hasawi-Küche →'). Reworded ix.faq0.linkText to 'Mehr zu den Gerichten auf der Seite Hasawi-Küche →' for a consistent, non-clichéd link register across both FAQ links; the → arrow is kept (JSON-LD strips it).
